newsitem.title: UK: Eurotunnel aims for first oper profit in '97.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel aims for first oper profit in '97.

text.p: Anglo-French Channel Tunnel operator Eurotunnel said on Thursday it aimed to achieve in 1997 an operating profit for the first time in its history.
The debt-laden firm posted a 1996 operating loss of 33 million stg after depreciation and provisions compared to a year-earlier loss of 192 million stg.
After interest and other charges, the loss for the year was 685 million stg, an improvement of about 240 million versus 1995, the firm said.
"In 1997, Eurotunnel aims to achieve an operating profit for the first time," the company said in a statement.
Eurotunnel's shares firmed 2.5p to 72 in London by 0755 GMT. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
